authority: Independent experimental model; the entity extension of section 14 is a project posit and a contract for the prototype. It records no official TEI standard and no adopted decision.

cases.description: R14 admits an entity record of each of the six kinds person, group, place, event, object and other while every other new collection stays empty.
A kind outside the closed set of six fails the closed-set check of constraint 11 with E_ENTITY_KIND on the kind field.
R14 lets an entity carry nothing but id, label and kind, since every fact about the thing is a claim carried elsewhere.
An empty label fails the nonempty-string shape check that section 5 applies to the new collections without change.
Constraint 5 keeps an entity valid that a mention denotes while no name claim exists for it.

cases.description: R17 admits an ordered parts array with one component of each of the six part kinds surname, forename, role-name, add-name, name-link and gen-name.
A part kind outside the closed set and a part with an empty form both fail with E_NAME_PART under constraint 11.
R17 requires a language tag on every name claim and admits a bare subtag, a tag with further subtags and the undetermined tag und.
A language tag outside the lexical form of BCP 47 fails with E_LANGUAGE on the language field.
The language tag is a required content field of the name claim, so its absence is a missing field under section 5 and gives E_SHAPE on the record.
Constraint 5 keeps a name claim valid for an entity that no text mentions, and the optional fraction of created is admitted.
R20 makes a superseding name claim of the same agent about the same entity the current one, and names_of returns it alone.

names_of returns the current name claims in validity order, claims without valid first, then ascending by from with an absent from first, then ascending by until with an absent until last, then by claim ID.
A withdrawn name claim is current under section 13 and appears in names_of only when include_withdrawn is true.
R15 accepts a reading node with the reserved proper-noun concept and one with the reserved pronoun concept as denotation subjects.

cases.description: Constraint 1 makes every nested alignment ID unique across the package, so an alignment repeating the ID of its carrier fails with E_DUPLICATE_ID.
A created value that fails the RFC 3339 lexical form or the calendar check gives E_CLAIM_FIELD on the field.
The created instant is a required pattern field of an extension claim, so its absence is a missing field under section 5 and gives E_SHAPE.
A status outside proposed, asserted and withdrawn and a certainty outside high, medium and low both give E_CLAIM_FIELD.
A validity scope whose from lies after its until and one that carries neither bound both give E_CLAIM_FIELD on the valid field.
Section 13 reads from as the start and until as the end of its calendar unit, so a year bound before a day bound of the same year is in order.
R11 ignores registry order, so this package and its permutation canonical-order-permuted carry the same validity and the same diagnostics.
